business_problem: When creating Norton Genie, Gen faced several development obstacles. Its team wanted to develop a prototype within weeks instead of months, an incredibly quick turnaround.
solution_summary: Learn how Gen, a leader in cybersecurity and the company behind brands such as Norton, Avast, and LifeLock, quickly developed a minimum viable product for Norton Genie, an AI scam detection application, using AWS. A study conducted by the Social Market Foundation found that one in five people were victims of scams between 2021 and 2023. With scams being a several-billion-dollar threat vector, Gen wanted to build a solution to protect consumers. The company chose to go further than classic phishing protection and URL-based blockers and created Norton Genie , a generative artificial intelligence (AI) product that customers use to scan emails, images, and web links for immediate vulnerability assessment. Gen chose to build a serverless architecture on Amazon Web Services (AWS). Source data enters the Gen workflow through its application services, stored or indexed in Amazon DynamoDB, processed with AWS Lambda, coordinated by AWS Step Functions.
